entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: A guardian angel from Serra's Realm twisted by the Phyrexians; the unrequited love of Crovax.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Nobleman of Urborg and Weatherlight crew member who loved Selenia and became a vampire.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: Archangel who protected Serra's Realm against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Morinfen
entities.description: Phyrexian creature that attacked Crovax's Estate.

entities.name: Gallowbraid
entities.description: Phyrexian creature that attacked Crovax's Estate.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: Killed in the fight at Crovax's Estate.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Wounded by Selenia in the Stronghold.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Twisted Selenia into a dark angel.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Where Selenia served the Phyrexian army.

events.summary: Selenia is captured by the Phyrexians and twisted into a dark angel assigned to watch over Crovax.
events.quote: used Phyrexian technology to twist her into a dark angel

events.summary: Crovax flees with the artifact controlling Selenia and joins the Weatherlight crew; Phyrexians slaughter his family.
events.quote: Crovax ran away with the artifact that controlled Selenia and joined the Weatherlight crew

events.summary: Crovax destroys the machine controlling Selenia and she flies away to Rath.
events.quote: Crovax destroyed the machine that controlled Selenia, and the angel flew away

events.summary: Crovax kills Selenia in the Stronghold and is cursed to become a vampire.
events.quote: in the instant that he killed her, a terrible curse befell Crovax, turning him into a vampire

events.summary: Yawgmoth recreates Selenia as a puppet used to reward Crovax.
Selenia emerges to take Crovax's spirit to the afterlife when he is killed.
events.quote: emerging to take his spirit to the afterlife and giving him a form of redemption

relations.quote: in the instant that he killed her
Crovax fell in love with Selenia, but the angel could not return his affection
an extraordinary warrior under the command of Radiant
